name: boj_get_inflation
description:
Japanese price indices, monthly, from FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, OECD series): cpi (all items), core_cpi (less food and energy) or ppi. Values are index levels, not rates.
Returns: series_code (FRED id), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped.
Inputs (* required): index_type* (cpi, core_cpi, ppi; schema default cpi); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-100; the last N observations, with no dates looking back N x 45 days; when omitted the whole history in the date range is returned).
For GDP, unemployment and production use boj_get_economic_indicator. Needs a FRED API key (FRED_API_KEY, config fred.api.key); without one the call fails with a message saying so.
Example: {"index_type": "core_cpi", "recent_periods": 13}
